integrity: All required finite comparisons were run in exact integer arithmetic with a fully supplied standalone checker. No independent mathematical audit is claimed. Historical priority is provisional, especially for the unavailable 1971 original.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-input Gini moduli are proved only at sizes 2 through 6; larger sizes carry analytic upper/lower linear-growth bounds. Unweighted real chains and the Basic selector only; strict L-infinity and least-squares selectors are different. The dated 2015 arXiv source is the precisely dated lead for archival classification, not a claimed first appearance of classical Basic regression, which predates it.
title: The six-site onset and linear growth of Gini instability in Basic Chebyshev isotonic regression
